zh: cookie 交换：无状态的源地址可达性验证。
HelloVerifyRequest：承载 cookie 的握手消息。
显式序号：记录头里的序号以便正确验证 MAC。
重传计时器：处理握手丢包的机制。
RC4 禁用：§4.1.2.2 的 MUST NOT。
en: Cookie exchange: a stateless return-routability check.
HelloVerifyRequest: the handshake message carrying the cookie.
Explicit sequence number: in the record header so the MAC verifies under reordering.
Epoch: separates records of successive handshakes.
Retransmission timers: the handshake answer to packet loss.
